status_definitions.SUPPORTED: Evidence supports use on the stated input class with the stated semantics.
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNEVALUATED: Software behavior is tested, but scientific capability has not been evaluated.
status_definitions.NOT_SUPPORTED: The claimed scientific capability is not supported by existing evidence.
status_definitions.SEALED: Historical control is closed and may not be rerun or reinterpreted without new human authority.

capabilities.name: exact_equivalence_verification
capabilities.supported_input_class: Plain-text symbolic expressions within the declared parser whitelist and resource limits.
capabilities.verification_semantics: ZERO alone is exact proof and may promote; NONZERO is exact disproof with preserved evidence; UNKNOWN fails closed.

capabilities.name: sessioned_certification_and_provenance
capabilities.supported_input_class: Verifier-supported expressions with explicit symbol namespaces.
capabilities.verification_semantics: Every proposal is recorded; promotion is bound to exact text/hash/namespace and an exact ZERO verdict.

capabilities.name: structure_first_observation
capabilities.supported_input_class: Parser-supported scalar, structural Sum/Product/Piecewise, and indexed-call expressions.
capabilities.verification_semantics: Observations are hypotheses and never certify equivalence without a separate ZERO verdict.

capabilities.name: scientific_assumption_contract
capabilities.supported_input_class: Scientific cases whose verifier-domain predicates can be explicitly declared or derived.
capabilities.verification_semantics: All required predicates must be DECLARED or DERIVED; new scientific assumptions require human authorization.

capabilities.name: source_grounded_obligation_packages
capabilities.supported_input_class: Source-displayed expressions that lower without changing their scientific domain or meaning.
capabilities.verification_semantics: Grounding/admission is necessary but does not replace exact obligation verification or constitute search success.

capabilities.name: first_order_lgg_substitution_observation
capabilities.supported_input_class: First-order repeated terms and substitution-level parameter families.
capabilities.verification_semantics: Structural observation only; every reconstructed equality still requires exact ZERO.

capabilities.name: representation_grammar_v1_and_program_ir
capabilities.supported_input_class: Research packages expressible in RepresentationGrammarV1 with explicit members, nodes, latent objects, operators, and obligations.
capabilities.verification_semantics: Canonical compilation/hashing is tested; a complete program is scientific success only if all required obligations are ZERO and admission gates pass.

capabilities.name: deterministic_and_random_representation_search
capabilities.supported_input_class: Admitted RPS cases over the frozen finite legal frontier.
capabilities.verification_semantics: No scientific run exists; reference-path reachability and software tests are not discovery evidence.

capabilities.name: symbolic_heuristic_representation_search
capabilities.supported_input_class: Admitted RPS cases with public structural features.
capabilities.verification_semantics: Heuristic score never overrides exact NONZERO or creates proof; no scientific effect was estimated.

capabilities.name: sol_conditioned_representation_search
capabilities.supported_input_class: Admitted cases with a fresh byte-exact case-bound replay from frozen SOL authority.
capabilities.verification_semantics: No RPS scientific run exists; prior SOL evidence remains historical and mixed.

capabilities.name: verifier_guided_representation_search
capabilities.supported_input_class: Admitted cases over the frozen M2 legal frontier with exact session feedback.
capabilities.verification_semantics: Diagnostic verifier calls are not feedback-guided search; no matched scientific effect was estimated.

capabilities.name: llm_legal_state_or_action_guidance
capabilities.supported_input_class: Admitted RPS cases with legal candidate states/actions and complete decision/usage provenance.
capabilities.verification_semantics: LLM decisions cannot certify equality; all selected programs require exact ZERO. No AI_SEARCH_ADVANTAGE is estimable.

capabilities.name: fresh_r2_reference_program
capabilities.supported_input_class: The admitted C9H4 CR3BP scalar-kernel family under its declared/derived assumptions.
capabilities.verification_semantics: Twelve stored and independently replayed ZERO obligations across three grammar variants.

capabilities.name: r3_plus_representation_program_discovery
capabilities.verification_semantics: No claim is adjudicable; diagnostic R3 ZERO does not establish discovery.

capabilities.name: free_form_llm_representation_advantage
capabilities.supported_input_class: No general supported class; prior cluster-local R2 did not generalize.
capabilities.verification_semantics: Historical exact receipts remain valid; the general AI advantage claim failed prior held-out review.

capabilities.name: guo_g0016_to_g0013
capabilities.supported_input_class: Historical control only under its frozen assumptions.
capabilities.verification_semantics: Authority remains UNKNOWN LEVEL_B; no promotion, new assumptions, or RPS search is permitted.

capabilities.name: context_grounded_verified_representation_discovery
capabilities.supported_input_class: No multi-family scientific task corpus was admitted under the final evaluator-first protocol.
capabilities.verification_semantics: One source-derived scalar Feshbach feasibility task has exact obligations, but no model treatment, context comparison, or discovery result occurred.
